links.outcome: O-RADS classification accuracy of LLM strategies versus original clinical reports against expert consensus
links.effect: Hybrid Gemini 3.6 Flash accuracy 99.2% (387/390) vs original clinical reports 87.7% (342/390) and end-to-end LLM strategies 65.6% to 95.9%.
links.quote: Its performance surpassed that of original clinical reports (accuracy, 87.7% [342 of 390]; weighted kappa = 0.94; 95% CI: 0.91-0.96) and end-to-end LLM strategies (accuracy range, 65.6% [256 of 390] to 95.9% [374 of 390]).

unlisted_practices: Decoupling LLM feature extraction from deterministic rule-based guideline execution (hybrid architecture) versus end-to-end LLM reasoning
Rule-informed prompting of end-to-end LLMs versus implicit-knowledge prompting

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates LLM-based O-RADS risk classification, comparing end-to-end LLM reasoning against a hybrid safeguard architecture that constrains LLM output to structured feature extraction followed by deterministic rule execution to mitigate hallucination and misclassification.

primary.practice: decoupling feature extraction from deterministic rule-based execution
